odd_map.parametrization: f(Z_j) = Σ_i phi__{Z_i}__{Z_j} Z_i  (+ psi__{Z_j} K for odd Z_j)
odd_map.phi_rule: phi__{Z_i}__{Z_j} is free iff p(Z_i) != p(Z_j) (f reverses parity)
odd_map.psi_rule: optional scalar part f(Z_j) ∋ psi__{Z_j} K for odd Z_j (K is even); it only contributes to the central component Z = 'K' as -psi([X,Y]). Set psi = 0 for the strict reading f: g -> g.

coboundary.symmetry: Stored only for index(X) <= index(Y) in basis_order; (δf)(Y,X) = -(-1)^{p(X)p(Y)} (δf)(X,Y)
coboundary.target_space: g ⊕ C K (Z = 'K' is the central component)
